limitations: Ground-truth camera masks validate geometry; no trained perception model

WORLD NONCOMPENSATED returns are time-gated, not moving-object deskewed
Sparse LiDAR depth cannot resolve every camera-only occluder
Parked ego and scripted traffic fixtures do not validate highway-speed ego-motion
